title: Subscribe Button Item For Youtubers
description: This mod adds Subscribe Button Item.
body:
# Subscribe Button Item For Youtubers

**Subscribe Button Item For Youtubers** is the perfect addition for content creators, streamers, and YouTubers who want to bring audience interaction directly into the world of Minecraft! This mod introduces a unique custom item – the Subscribe Button – which is ideal for map decoration, viewer rewards, or dynamic community events.

## 🛠️ Technical Requirements
This mod is built for the Fabric ecosystem. To ensure it runs correctly, make sure you have installed:
* **Fabric Loader** (compatible only with 1.21.8)
* **Fabric API** – **Strictly required!** The mod will not launch without this dependency.

## 🎮 How to Obtain the Item
The Subscribe Button is a technical and decorative utility item, meaning it does not have a survival crafting recipe. To get it:
1. You must have server operator privileges (**OP**) or have cheats enabled in singleplayer/multiplayer.
2. Open the in-game chat and execute the following command:
`/give @s subscribebuttonitem:subscribe_button`

## ✨ Features
* **Custom Texture**: Features a distinct design directly inspired by the iconic "Subscribe" button.
* **Creator-Focused**: A great tool for enhancing YouTube videos, Shorts, TikToks, or live streams.
* **Lightweight & Clean**: Optimized code that guarantees high performance and seamless compatibility with other Modrinth mods.
